# Search for outbound flights from Colorado Springs to San Antonio on May 18, 2025, with American Airlines in first class
outbound_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
    end_airport_city="San Antonio",
    departure_date=["May 18, 2025"],
    airline=["AA"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save outbound flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_flights)

# Search for return flights from San Antonio to Colorado Springs on May 24, 2025, with American Airlines in first class
return_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="San Antonio",
    end_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
    departure_date=["May 24, 2025"],
    airline=["AA"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save return flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)

# Retrieve outbound flight results from cache for filtering
prior_outbound = get_results_from_cache(key="outbound_flights")

# Filter outbound flights to include only first class and American Airlines
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=prior_outbound,
    flight_class=["first"],
    airline=["AA"]
)

# Save filtered outbound flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights", value=filtered_outbound)

# Retrieve return flight results from cache for filtering
prior_return = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")

# Filter return flights to include only first class and American Airlines
filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=prior_return,
    flight_class=["first"],
    airline=["AA"]
)

# Save filtered return flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# No planning needed as all required actions are complete
print("No planning needed")
